clauses.reason: Reachability debt and failure debt have different obligations.

updates.rationale: Reaching a node repays missing execution; skipping cannot erase an observed failure.
updates.statement: An owed node owed only because it was unreached is discharged when a later run reports a non-failing terminal outcome, including a declared skip; receipts identify the node and outcome. Failed or retry-recovered nodes remain owed until passing or existing explicit journal evidence release; skipping cannot discharge failure debt. Preserve provenance across failed and partial gates. This refines the passing requirement of EFFICIENCY-FAIL-001 without changing retirement or first-failure rules.

decisions.reason: A job ceiling establishes missing execution, not a failing test. Requiring a platform-excluded node to pass can never succeed on this host. Reaching it repays that debt. Treating every skip as payment would launder actual failures; retain failure precedence and explicit journal release. Reopen if runners cannot distinguish non-failing terminal outcomes from unreached execution.
